description: Vertical slice for AAW MULTIROUTING RUNTIME CONTRACT V0.1: conditional FIRST_MATCH routing after review, explicit repair branch lineage, ALL_MATCHES fan-out after the machine gate, and a fail-closed human fallback.

nodes.instructions: Implement the supplied goal in the isolated worktree. Keep the change narrowly scoped and add or update focused tests. Do not merge, push, create a PR, or alter the canonical checkout.
acceptance: The requested behavior is implemented in the isolated worktree.
Changes stay within the goal and stated scope.

nodes.instructions: Complete the implementation started by N01. Honour every carry_forward constraint supplied in the node package. Do not widen the scope.
acceptance: The implementation is complete against the goal.
Focused tests are present where applicable.

nodes.instructions:
Review the implementation in a fresh, read-only context. Assess the goal, the acceptance criteria, the diff, the changed files and the machine evidence. Do not edit files.

Return a structured result only. You do not choose the next node: set `verdict` and the deterministic gate routes.

verdict = PASS when the work meets the acceptance criteria.
verdict = REPAIR when the work is fixable inside the current scope; then `next_brief` is mandatory and becomes the binding brief of the repair branch.
verdict = BLOCKED when the work cannot proceed without a human decision.

Use `carry_forward` for constraints that must survive into every downstream brief, and `artifacts` for evidence paths a later node needs.
acceptance: The review ran in a fresh read-only context.
verdict is one of PASS, REPAIR, BLOCKED.
A REPAIR verdict carries a concrete, self-contained next_brief.

nodes.instructions:
Repair template. This node is never entered directly: the gate mints an explicit lineage child from it and the reviewer's next_brief is appended below as INHERITED_BRIEF.

Make only the changes the inherited brief requires. Do not widen the scope, do not refactor adjacent code, and do not touch the canonical checkout.
acceptance: Every point of the inherited brief is addressed.
No change outside the scope the brief names.

nodes.instructions: Run the pre-approved focused test command without a shell.
Fan-out branch: hardening. Apply the hardening work the verified implementation now permits. Honour every carry_forward constraint.
acceptance: Hardening is applied without widening the goal.

nodes.instructions: Fan-out branch: migration. Write the forward-only migration the verified implementation requires, with a dry-run mode. Honour every carry_forward constraint.
acceptance: The migration is forward-only and has a dry-run mode.

nodes.instructions: Human acceptance. ACCEPT CANDIDATE records READY_FOR_EXTERNAL_INTEGRATION. The runner never merges, pushes or opens a PR.
acceptance: A human verdict is recorded against the candidate.
